title: Warm Spiced Mediterranean Chicken Thigh Tagine
description: A rich and aromatic lacto-vegetarian dish featuring chicken thighs, perfect for a midnight craving, with a blend of floral and spicy flavors, simmered to perfection in a traditional tagine pot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken thighs to the pot and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the ground cumin, smoked paprika, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and diced tomatoes to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 30 minutes, then stir in the crumbled feta cheese.
Continue baking the tagine for an additional 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the chicken is cooked through.
